enunciado: Rotate {10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60} k = 2 positions to the left (the result starts with 30) using the three-reversal technique: reverse [0, k-1], reverse [k, n-1] and reverse everything.
objetivos: Build a transformation out of a simpler one
Work with subranges of an array
pistas: Write reverse(a, from, to) for a subrange.
Show the array after each reversal to understand the trick.
Use k % n in case k is larger than n.
